name: Furry Shakespeare: To Date Or Not To Date Cat Girls?
source:
Welcome back to the proving ground for princes and princesses, heirs and heiresses; where people from all over the globe come for higher learning, and the cheerleaders are literal witches. Only, things are a bit different, and it's not just that you are all now seniors.

Besides all the academic fun, there seems to be something.... brewing. Double double, toil and trouble? Can you pull off the perfect date as well as save the world? Well, I mean, can you? It's a simple question.

F-bombs are dropped. Sexual innuendo abounds. All this and more as you try to survive the craziest senior year ever!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/947060/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎回到王子、公主、继承人们的试炼场；来自世界各地的人们在此接受高等教育，而啦啦队员竟然真的是女巫。只是，一切似乎有些不同了，而且变化并不只是因为你们如今都成了高年级学生。

除了充满乐趣的学业生活，某种东西似乎也在酝酿……“双重双重，辛劳与麻烦”？你能安排一场完美约会，同时拯救世界吗？我是说，你真的能吗？这只是个简单的问题。

脏话满天飞，性暗示无处不在。想办法熬过史上最疯狂的高年级生活吧！

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/947060/]Steam[/url]]
